name: Fit protective equipment
short_description: Select, inspect, and adjust one item of protective equipment for a named activity.
self_assessment: I can inspect and fit one item of protective equipment without help before an activity.
description: Select, inspect, and adjust one item of protective equipment for a named activity. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Fit eye protection before dusty work
safety_note: Poorly fitted equipment may fail; inspect for damage, follow its fitting instructions, and replace equipment that cannot be secured.
